$comment: Pinned KTX-Software toolchain (the `ktx create` CLI the texture step shells out to). RID keys match .NET RuntimeIdentifier values; URLs are the GitHub release assets. SHA256 digests were computed from downloads whose SHA1 was cross-checked against the published .sha1 sidecars where Khronos ships one (the Linux tarballs; the Windows .exe installers have none). WINDOWS ships an NSIS .exe rather than an archive — no unpacker handles modern NSIS payloads, so format 'nsis' means the bootstrap runs the installer with /S /D=<dir>, which writes the same files into the cache without touching Program Files. It is an installer rather than an archive, so it also registers an uninstall entry; that is the price of Khronos not publishing a Windows archive. macOS ships a .pkg with the same problem and no silent-install flag that lands in an arbitrary directory, so darwin RIDs stay absent and the bootstrap fails there with guidance to install KTX-Software and set PARADISE_KTX_PATH. To bump: download each asset, cross-check the .sha1 sidecar where one exists, recompute SHA256, update version + entries.
$versionComment: v5 is what Paradise.Assets.Pipeline's KtxCreate targets — `ktx create`, the replacement for the removed legacy toktx. 5.0.0-rc2 is a PRERELEASE: Khronos marks it so because KTX specification Document Revision 5 is not yet published, not because the tool is unfinished. It is the only 5.x there is; move to the final tag when one ships.
